notes.title: Jumpbound is out now on Steam
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! After two years in the making, we're excited to share that Jumpbound is finally available on Steam! Looking forward to see what you think about the game and how high can you climb.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ftrKCXcGf2g;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Jumpbound is an atmospheric and challenging first-person platformer, where you get more and more air jumps and dashes as you progress. Set on a mysterious and beautiful planet, Jumpbound combines meditative exploration with high-stakes platforming. The game is filled with collectible secrets hidden so well even the developers can't find all of them.[/p][p][/p][p]We opened a Discord simultaneously with the launch, so you have a place to come talk with us or let us know about any bugs or other unexpected issues that may occur. [/p][p][/p][p]Join our Discord here: [url="https://discord.gg/Shs5ejJY"]https://discord.gg/Shs5ejJY[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Let the climb begin![/p]

notes.title: Jumpbound is in Clemmy's Best Indie Games Fall Showcase 2025!
notes.content: [p]Good news, everyone! Jumpbound was selected to the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/26397247/sale/BIGFallShowcase2025"]Clemmy's Best Indie Games Fall Showcase 2025[/url], which is a curated showcase of some of the most exciting new and upcoming indie games. We're honored to be part of this great event![/p][p][/p][p]The showcase has all the amazing game trailers in their Youtube video. Go check out Jumpbound's new trailer and all the other cool indie games here: [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/BQ3rDpbvxIg?si=QFhkayFQDJIIVJLB&t=12095"][/dynamiclink][/p]
